evals.prompt: Create a three-page A4 institutional report in DOCX with a repeating-header table and verify its layout.
evals.expected_output: Build with explicit DXA dimensions, repeating table headers (tblHeader/cantSplit), validate with validate.py, convert to PDF via soffice.py, render pages with pdftoppm, and visually inspect every page.
expectations: Uses explicit DXA widths and A4 dimensions
Renders to PDF and page images and inspects rendered pages

evals.prompt: Add tracked changes to an existing contract DOCX without leaving AI attribution in author metadata.
evals.expected_output: Unpack the DOCX, use sibling w:del and w:ins elements with the established or Editor author (never an AI name), repack, validate, and visually inspect.
expectations: Uses established author, user-specified author, or 'Editor'
Never places AI names in author metadata
Validates and renders the final repacked DOCX
